text: Regulations dated 02.08.2024, all Internet Service Providers, whose total number of subscribers as on last day of the preceding financial year is more than ten thousand, are required to submit the performance monitoring report. As on 30th June 2025, there were 108 internet service providers having more than 10,000 subscriber base who are required to submit the performance monitoring report of broadband (wireline) service. Out of 108 internet service providers, one service provider namely M/s. Nuron Communication Private Limited has not submitted the PMR. This report covers performances of 107 broadband service providers’ vis-à- vis the QoS benchmarks prescribed by TRAI.
